Questions, answered straight.

How do I claim a spot?

Enter your brand details, choose your starting boost from $1, and complete payment. Your public profile goes live and you appear on the leaderboard.

How do boosts work?

Anyone can add money to any spot. Every dollar raises its total and its rank — boost your own spot or back a brand you love.

What happens when I pass another spot?

You take its rank instantly. The leaderboard updates live, so rivalries and comebacks play out in public.

How do payments work right now?

We’re in Phase 1: after claiming, you complete payment manually (USDT on TRC-20, BEP-20, or Solana) and our team verifies it, usually within a few hours. Automatic payment processing is coming soon.

What does the winner get?

The #1 spot holds the champion crown and the homepage spotlight — the most-viewed placement on the site. Bragging rights included.
